Aziza Alizada, 21, from Afghanistan, miscaried while living at the port of Piraeus in Athens, Greece, after suffering extreme food poisoning. Two-hundred people were taken to the hospital in one night and seven women miscarried. It is still unknown exactly what caused the poisoning – some say it was the rotten chiken handed out for dinner that night while many refugees believe they were poisoned on purspose. August 3, 2016.
